entries.source: Regesten der Pfalzgrafen am Rhein 1214 - 1508: Karlsr. Coph. 532ᵇ,140ᵛ. Stuttg. Pf. Coph. 34ʳ.
entries.german: Eberhard von Rosenberg übergibt dem pfalzgrafen sein viertel an der veste Rosenberg mit dem vorhof zu lehen auf.
entries.english: Eberhard von Rosenberg surrenders his quarter-share of the Rosenberg fortress with its forecourt to the Count Palatine to be held as a fief

facts.content: surrendered his quarter share of Veste Rosenberg and its forecourt to the Count Palatine as a fief.
